hook.text: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
son: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,
hook.note: When His own asked how to pray, the Son did not give them a formula. He gave them a Father, and told them to say so out loud. Everything in this Bible follows from that one word. Come, hear your Father’s voice.

short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Cantonese — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Cantonese Bible, paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
天父心意聖經：第一本印出嚟、你睇得到係邊個喺度講嘢嘅聖經。我哋天父嘅說話用藍色，聖子嘅用紅色，聖靈嘅用紫色。
一百幾年嚟，紅字標示出聖子喺邊度講嘢。但係我哋嘅父講得更多——喺呢本廣東話聖經入面，佢講咗 202,078 個字，分佈喺 5,615 節經文入面——而直到而家，佢每一句說話都同家譜用同一隻黑色墨水印。佢一直都喺度講嘢；只係從來冇一本聖經俾你睇到佢喺邊度講。
顏色係歸屬嘅記號，唔係引號。我哋天父嘅說話，無論由邊個口中忠實咁傳出，都仍然係佢嘅說話；佢從來冇講過嘅說話，絕對唔會著色；敘述保持黑色。
當門徒問點樣禱告，聖子冇俾佢哋一套方法，而係俾咗佢哋一位父：「我哋在天嘅父，願你嘅名被尊為聖」（馬太福音 6:9）。呢本聖經入面嘅一切，都源自嗰一個稱呼。我哋呼叫：「阿爸！父！」（羅馬書 8:15）。
佢唔係遙遠。佢冇對你失望。佢係你天上嘅父，你係佢心愛嘅孩子。如果「父親」對你嚟講唔係一個帶嚟安慰嘅詞，呢本聖經就更加係為你預備嘅：呢度所啟示嘅父，唔係破碎嘅人間父親嘅投影，而係原型——天上地上嘅每一個家族，都係由佢得名嘅。
每卷書都有一篇引言，1,354 條註釋服侍讀者，而唔係學者；一頁獻辭寫住收禮人嘅名。完整嘅聖經——66 卷書，1,189 章，31,085 節，冇刪減。
忠實譯自希伯來文、亞蘭文同希臘文原文；每一個版本都譯自 Father's Heart Bible™。6 x 9 吋，平裝同精裝，全彩印刷。一份禮物、一份紀念、一份傳承。
為每一個講廣東話嘅家庭同教會——喺香港、澳門、廣東、海外，以至世界各地——等佢哋用自己嘅語言聽到天父嘅聲音。
接待天父。聆聽佢嘅聲音。佢嘅心向住你。

faq.q: Is the Cantonese edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Cantonese, 700 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Cantonese edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Cantonese edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Cantonese text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Cantonese Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/yue.
